description: This file defines a custom Tiptap node extension for handling variable mentions within a rich text editor, including rendering, attributes, suggestion behavior, and keyboard shortcuts.

classes.name: VariableExtension
classes.description: A Tiptap node extension for variable mention nodes, including rendering, attributes, suggestion logic, and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the variable node, including rendering functions and suggestion behavior.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Defines HTML attributes for the variable node, such as 'id' and 'label'.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Specifies how to parse HTML into this node type.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Defines how to render the node as HTML, supporting deprecated label rendering.

methods.name: renderText
methods.description: Defines how to render the node as text.

methods.name: addKeyboardShortcuts
methods.description: Adds keyboard shortcut handling, e.g., for backspace deletion of the variable node.

methods.name: addProseMirrorPlugins
methods.description: Adds ProseMirror plugins, specifically the suggestion plugin for variable mentions.
